ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels on the lateral lobes and 60% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels in the central region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white pixel blobs occupying the outer thirds of both lobes; a large, central, contiguous low-intensity dark region; small high-intensity yellow-white clusters at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central notch with an approximate 85-degree interior angle and a depth of roughly 15% of the total visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency serrations (5-15 pixel depth) and several larger macro-notches on the upper margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the distal edges tapering into a straighter trajectory toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, circular, high-contrast yellow-white pixel clusters (barnacles) located on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous high-contrast white linear streaks (rake marks) of varying lengths (50-200 pixels) distributed across the central dark pigmentation zone.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks on the central fluke surface and significant barnacle encrustations on the lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of dark, low-intensity organic material (kelp) entangled with the barnacle colony on the right distal tip.
